_comment: The garden. Its whole design rests on one distinction the product cares deeply about:
EARNED seeds are granted only by real shared experiences and can NEVER be bought. A Sakura seed means the
pod actually went to Japan. A Memory Tree means they hit a real milestone. These carry the meaning.
SHOP seeds and decorations are cosmetic, cost Peanuts, and never represent a specific moment.
Two further rules that must survive any refactor: plants never die and growth never decreases, so the garden
never punishes a pod for being away; and plot capacity comes only from levelling up, never from a purchase.

special.label: Special
special.blurb: Something you did together that mattered.

species._comment: What a fully grown plant becomes, and the Peanuts harvesting it yields. 'experience' is the real-life moment the species stands for.

shopSeeds._comment: Purchasable with Peanuts. Cosmetic only. growsSeconds is real elapsed time from planting.

crops._comment: The lighter farm crops, unlocked progressively by level. Shorter grow times and smaller yields than the meaningful species.

growth._comment: growth = min(1, elapsedSeconds / growsSeconds + waterBoost). A pre-seeded plant (null plantedAt) and any decoration are always 1.0.

waterBoostPerWatering.why: Watering nudges a plant forward by 30% of its total grow time. Capped so watering repeatedly cannot instantly mature a plant.

memoryTagToSpecies._comment: Which species a memory's tag grows. Checked in this order; the first match wins.

memoryTagToEarnedSeed._comment: Which earned seed a memory grants. Evaluated in order: an explicit milestone tag wins, then a Japan location match (which is why Sakura is special), then the general tags.

tripToEarnedSeed._comment: Completing any trip grants a Pine Cone, except a Japan trip which grants the rarer Sakura.

slotLayout._comment: How slots are arranged as a grid on the raised bed in the 3D world. Columns are ceil(sqrt(capacity)), and the grid is centred on the bed.
